class Animal {
  name = 'animal';
}

class Dog extends Animal {
  bark() { return 'woof'; }
}

class AnimalHandler {
  constructor(animal: Animal);
  constructor(animal: Animal) { console.log(animal.name); }
}

class DogHandler {
  constructor(dog: Dog) { console.log(dog.bark()); }
}

class InheritedHandler extends AnimalHandler {}

function run(Handler: typeof AnimalHandler) {
  return new Handler(new Dog());
}

const Handler: typeof InheritedHandler = DogHandler;
new Handler(new Dog());
run(DogHandler);

type DogCallback = { handle(dog: Dog): string };
const callback: DogCallback['handle'] = (animal: Animal) => animal.name;
interface AnimalMethods { handle(animal: Animal): string }
const method: AnimalMethods = { handle(dog: Dog) { return dog.bark(); } };
console.log(callback(new Dog()), method.handle(new Dog()));
